title: Better Create
description: This is a modpack containing the create mod and many add-ons related to it.
body:
![Better Create logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/281bc6dd7a3dad9933bd18b4212a3ad8fc0e0e89.png) **This modpack combines the innovative mechanics of Create with a variety of complementary mods to enhance your Minecraft experience. Dive into automation, exploration, and creativity like never before!** ### List of mods: - Create: A powerful engineering mod that lets you build complex mechanical contraptions and automation using gears, belts, and other moving parts. - Create Enchantment Industry: Adds enchanting mechanics integrated with the Create mod’s machinery, allowing automated and custom enchantment workflows. - Create Jetpack: Fly around your world effortlessly with jetpacks that integrate perfectly with the Create mod’s tech. - Create Cobblestone: Adds tools and machines specifically designed to produce and manage cobblestone resources efficiently. - Create: Copycats+: Enhances the Create mod by adding new "Copycat" blocks that mimic the appearance of other blocks, offering more creative building options. - Create: Structures: Expands your world with new custom structures, enriching exploration and adventure within the Create ecosystem. - Create_Better_Villagers: Improves villager AI and trading mechanics, making your interactions with NPCs more dynamic and rewarding. - Just Enough Items (JEI): A must-have utility mod that provides an in-game recipe viewer and item lookup tool, making crafting and mod navigation simple.
